Using fees joined to their orders (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`) and those orders' users (`orders.userlink` = `users.userstamp`), drop any fee without a match. Compute the average fee rate (`feerate`, ignoring missing values) for each pair of orderslink and account scope (`users.acctscope`). Keep only the pairs whose average is strictly above the mean of all the pair averages, and work out how far each one exceeds that mean. Within each account scope, rank the pairs by that excess from largest to smallest and give me the top 3 pairs in each scope. Show orderslink, account scope, average fee rate, excess, and the pair's rank within its scope, all unrounded. Compute the mean of pair averages over all pairs with a non-null average, before the strictly-above filter.
queries:
WITH pair_avg AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink,
         u.acctscope AS acctscope,
         AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg
),
excess AS (
  SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate,
         p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_avg p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rank_in_scope
  FROM excess
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank_in_scope
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_in_scope <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank_in_scope;

WITH pair_avgs AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink,
         u.acctscope AS acctscope,
         AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
  HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avgs
),
excess AS (
  SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate,
         p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_avgs p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rank_in_scope
  FROM excess
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank_in_scope
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_in_scope <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank_in_scope;
